_comment: Shared enums whose variants grow across apps (ADR 0049 section 4 and the rule 39 lessons: a variant added to a shared enum updates every app in the same change). A non-test `match` in an app on one of them has no catch-all arm, so a new variant is a compile error in every app, not a silent default. Test: test/shared-enum-matches.test.mjs; baseline: baselines/shared-enum-matches.json (may only shrink).
